reply.summary: Iannau is a covert state operative whose eyes fire pale stunning bolts and crimson shock beams. Overuse leaves her vision raw and aching, so she rations each volley on long missions.

feats.scene: Iannau drops a charging guard with one crimson pulse from her gaze.
Iannau shrugs off a baton strike across the ribs and keeps walking.

reply.summary: Barin is a young ring-bearing guardian who wakes on a hospital bed convinced he is holding a gate against demons. His green light is real even if his battlefield is imagined, and it carries him through a long death and return.

feats.scene: Barin hurls a lance of emerald light that collapses a ruined bunker.
Barin survives an ambush barrage that leaves him feverish but breathing.

reply.summary: Barin Char is a blue-skinned space patrol officer watching over a crowd of worlds in a distant sector. Separated from his ring on a border planet, he is undone by a parasite hatched in a rock hive.

feats.scene: Barin Char seals a collapsing mine shaft with a wall of solid light.
Barin Char endures being cocooned in resin without his ring, before the brood bursts out.

reply.summary: Talna is a bitter laboratory engineer who builds a helmet that bends swarms of vermin to his will. With a mutating beam he turns the pests into snarling monsters and aims them at his former employers.

feats.scene: Talna sends a tide of mutated vermin through a sealed lab door, buckling the steel frame.
Talna stumbles through a collapsing corridor with only bruises.

reply.summary: Melornti is a grim future peddler who sells scented resin that numbers the mind against a bleak, crowded world. He recruits a hired gun as a bodyguard and pays for it with a fatal plunge from his own airship.

feats.scene: Melornti swings a punch at a stranger inside his cramped cabin.
Melornti absorbs a pounding from a gunman before going over the rail.

reply.summary: Anseanu is a retired heir to an ancient line of fire-wielders, passed down by touch through a metagene made to hunt pale shapeshifting invaders. He wears inherited plate with force-field gauntlets and a blade that parts nearly anything.

feats.scene: Anseanu releases a wave of heat from his palms that melts a parked truck.
Anseanu takes a heavy blow on his gauntlet field and holds his ground.

reply.summary: Celstiu is a ruthless soldier who injects himself with a stolen serum and becomes a hulking, faster, tougher brute. He turns his borrowed strength against a squad of time travellers.

feats.scene: Celstiu flips an armoured van with one swing of his arm.
Celstiu walks through a volley of rifle fire without slowing.
Celstiu closes a courtyard in the blink of an eye to tackle a runner.

reply.summary: Iumcasu is a comic enthusiast handed borrowed powers at a convention by a stranger with a hidden plot. He gains water-dwelling abilities and extra might, loses them within days, and turns on his patron after witnessing cruelty.

feats.scene: Iumcasu lifts a loaded crate overhead and throws it across a dock.
Iumcasu is thrown into a wall and stands back up.
Iumcasu cuts through harbour water faster than a motorboat.

reply.summary: Veote is a brilliant physicist whose radical quantum theories cost him a tenure and a start-up. He is lured into a secret government project in a desert fort, where his work begins to bend the rules of motion.

feats.scene: Veote bolts an experimental coil to its stand and fires it across a test bunker.
Veote is flung against a concrete wall by a failed experiment and gets up.

reply.summary: Orvinel is a lab scientist and married grandfather who channels a boundless well of motion and stands among the world's champions. His blazing sprints drain power from a hidden source that never runs dry.

feats.scene: Orvinel plants a single sprinting punch that flattens a brick warehouse.
Orvinel rides out a collapsing bridge deck without a scratch.
Orvinel laps a harbour city faster than the echo of his own footsteps.

reply.summary: Reoteor is a police lab scientist who ran as the elder champion before his protege took over. He gave his life to save the world and left behind a legacy of speed in the family.

feats.scene: Reoteor threads a colossal sprint through a failing plant to haul out a thousand workers.
Reoteor holds off a collapsing reactor shell for one terrible heartbeat.
Reoteor circles a continent before a falling girder lands.

reply.summary: Areon is a scientist-turned-sprinter who served on a league of champions before a god of war began a two-year campaign against the planet. His link to an endless motion source lets him outpace ordinary threats.

feats.scene: Areon rams a runaway tanker clear of a crowded bridge.
Areon survives a rolling car crash and keeps running.
Areon crosses a river valley faster than a shout carries.

reply.summary: Tasirse is a hero of a doomed alternate team, the sprinter who falls when their leader is poisoned by a mad laughing toxin. He is overpowered by his own cables and strangled by a stretching ally.

feats.scene: Tasirse hammers a barricade of steel plate flat with a blur of quick punches.
Tasirse struggles against cables wound across his chest until his strength fails.
Tasirse crosses a hangar before the first echo returns.

reply.summary: Monnute is a former hero who turned into a bloodthirsty night-stalker when a plague swept the world. He hunts an old friend from another reality at blinding speed until arrows through the back stop him.

feats.scene: Monnute tears through a steel door and a guard behind it in one rush.
Monnute takes a wooden shaft in the back and lunges forward once more.
Monnute vanishes from one rooftop and appears on another before the dust settles.

reply.summary: Nauirnamo is a grizzled old sprinter who was forced to run in an enormous wheel to feed a nation's lights. Freed by a rebel crew, he trades quips about the young and joins their cause.

feats.scene: Nauirnamo sprints for years inside a giant wheel and lights up a country's grid.
Nauirnamo walks away from his chains after years of grinding labour.
Nauirnamo blurs through a wasteland camp and snaps every lock in a breath.

reply.summary: Miliri is a blur of a recruit who never took up a hero's career before a ring of green light chose him. He flies, fires bright bolts and shapes glowing barriers while a lightning link to motion still hums inside.

feats.scene: Miliri sculpts a glowing hammer and demolishes a pier with one swing.
Miliri holds a barrier against a falling tower of masonry.
Miliri sprints through the sky above a harbour with a streak of green light.

reply.summary: Vatelsto is a gifted inventor and doting father whose speed passes to his daughter. He shrinks a heroic outfit into a belt buckle, mentors a young apprentice and leaves behind a legacy of quick runners.

feats.scene: Vatelsto slams into a rogue robot at full sprint and cracks its chassis.
Vatelsto skids across pavement after a collision and shakes it off.
Vatelsto streaks across a city skyline in a few breaths.

reply.summary: Lintiu is a skeleton kept moving by a trapped wellspring of speed after his universe's collapse. He hides in a ruined orbital station with other survivors, then spends himself to halt a creeping blight.

feats.scene: Lintiu lets his stored speed erupt at once and stops a wall of withering blight.
Lintiu endures years of scavenging among crumbling ruins as a bare skeleton.
Lintiu darts between the gaps of a falling station before the debris moves.

reply.summary: Tasiin is a forensic analyst whose lab accident gave him unmatched running and control over his own molecules. In a battle across a portal, he hits a bloodthirsty doppelganger with a stream of blows.

feats.scene: Tasiin strikes a charging vampire with a hail of punches that cracks a concrete column.
Tasiin is thrown through a shopfront and sits up laughing.
Tasiin searches every block of the surrounding district in seconds.

reply.summary: Sueolas is a cloned champion rebuilt by scientists in a far-future lab, missing some of the original's powers and all of its memory. Without a protective field his friction can burn him alive, so every sprint is a gamble.

feats.scene: Sueolas spins around the planet's curve and blasts a column of wind at a rival.
Sueolas endures singeing friction at the edge of burning up.
Sueolas races a rocket sled across a salt flat and wins.

reply.summary: Ternite is a careful lab analyst whose record is spotless and whose speed is so great that he leaves no shadow. He can vibrate through walls and into other eras, but running too hard slowly burns his body out.

feats.scene: Ternite vibrates through a vault wall and strikes a safecracker before the alarm sounds.
Ternite withstands a gas explosion in his lab that changed him forever.
Ternite crosses a whole district and returns before the clock ticks.

reply.summary: Lustnu is a screaming trapped soul, one of four runners fused with a wild storm of motion in a ruined world. The tempest ages everything it touches to dust or to a time before birth.

feats.scene: Lustnu spreads a howling storm across a plain, ageing every ruin to powder.
Lustnu is held together by the storm itself through a thousand years of torment.
Lustnu streaks over the wasteland in one long howl.

reply.summary: Anicele is a young man who survived a lab fire and a lightning strike that soaked him in a healing serum. He guards his city by night with rapid reflexes and fights a child who ages backward.

feats.scene: Anicele delivers a hundred quick strikes that wreck a gang's armoured car.
Anicele walks out of a burning building with only singed gloves.
Anicele races past a pair of twins before they can draw breath.

reply.summary: Torlis is a widowed drifter who drives a battered car across a blasted desert after an alien invasion. Guided by a last relic of magic, he carries it through raiders to the old landing field and brings a spring to life.

feats.scene: Torlis unleashes the relic's water and a green oasis spreads over the dunes.
Torlis rolls his car through a raider ambush and walks away.

reply.summary: Staumi is a restless student who burns through his days at a hurried pace with a bottomless reserve of motion. He joins a league's first mission and treats the whole world like a playground.

feats.scene: Staumi hits a robot guardian so many times that it caves in.
Staumi bounces off a wall mid-sprint and laughs.
Staumi runs laps around a mountain base before the others finish a sentence.

reply.summary: Seoteaul is a yellow-eyed teenager whose place on a team is swallowed when a copy takes his mantle. His timeline branches after a team splits apart in a vow never to become the harsh adults they glimpsed.

feats.scene: Seoteaul launches himself shoulder-first into a security door and tears it off its rails.
Seoteaul tumbles across a rooftop after a bad landing and springs upright.
Seoteaul zigzags down a long avenue so fast the traffic seems to stand still.

reply.summary: Tesan is an ace aviator who paints his plane black and forms a squadron of pilots from many lands after the invaders crush his farm. Once, a chemical and a surge of current stretched him to twenty feet and charged him with heat.

feats.scene: Tesan strafes a supply convoy and wrecks every truck in a single pass.
Tesan survives a plane crash into a forest and walks out.
Tesan banks a fighter plane through a canyon in a dogfight.

reply.summary: Raulenso is a scarred inventor whose device meant to erase a blemish wiped away his whole face. He and his gang then use the machine to blank out their victims during a spree of thefts.

feats.scene: Raulenso fires the machine at a jeweller and the shop falls to chaos.
Raulenso takes a heavy beating from two masked fighters and keeps laughing.

reply.summary: Oriuter is a government agent fired in public and quietly hired in secret, adept with locks, chemistry and wrestling holds. His jilted fiancee follows him and becomes a spy herself.

feats.scene: Oriuter flips a pursuer over a cafe table with a wrestling throw.
Oriuter takes a blow from a pistol grip and shakes it off.

reply.summary: Tatorse is a failed actor turned malleable mud-man who can stretch, swell, leap and regrow lost pieces. He breaks out of prison with a gang of crooks and plans to rob a gold vault.

feats.scene: Tatorse swells to a giant and crushes a parked bus with his fist.
Tatorse reforms his body after a truck drives straight through him.

reply.summary: Olasne is a toy designer robbed of his patent, who builds a flashy battle suit and goes after his old boss. Years later he ends up a floating head and gets hired to rig a foreign election.

feats.scene: Olasne fires the suit's cannons and wrecks a loading dock.
Olasne shrugs off a truck impact inside the armoured suit.

reply.summary: Telnumva is a grey dog who travels with a boy and a warrior hero. When a hunter kills him, the war god is pressured into giving him back his life.

feats.scene: Telnumva snaps at a bandit's ankle and sends him sprawling.
Telnumva is struck down by a spear and is later revived whole.

reply.summary: Celti is a green-haired thug who leads a biker gang on a doomed world, empowered by his people's gifts of strength and flight. He bullies his way through a back alley until a better fighter appears.

feats.scene: Celti smashes a hover cycle through a stone wall and levels the street.
Celti shrugs off a rooftop collapse and continues his ride.
Celti flies a long straight line over his gang's hideout in seconds.

reply.summary: Satia is a soldier resurrected from a stored sample who finds himself weaker on a new world. He rebels against his commander, then returns to the fold and serves in a fortress of ice and crystal.

feats.scene: Satia hurls a thrown boulder through a warehouse wall.
Satia is flattened by a blast in a warehouse and rises.

reply.summary: Starnles is a sun-born goddess of felines, war and love who rules over cats and answers to a divine household. She scratches a drunken thunder-god across the face when he offers an insult, and tracks a lost brother across ages.

feats.scene: Starnles rakes her claws across a stone altar and splits it down the middle.
Starnles stands unharmed in a burning temple for a long night.

reply.summary: Senesaun is an ancient guardian of cosmic order who walks the world in the shape of a pet. She sees reality as it truly is and can slip her mind into any feline, speaking through it.

feats.scene: Senesaun shatters a rival's ritual circle with a single glance of her red-white eyes.
Senesaun stands unmoved while chaos tears at the world around her.

reply.summary: Oraliu is a rescued gorilla who works for a masked hero and patrols the deep jungle. He dives in to help during a chase and shows up exactly when needed.

feats.scene: Oraliu hurls a poacher's truck door across a clearing.
Oraliu takes a net-gun shot to the chest and keeps going.

reply.summary: Rnerer is a cow saved from a slaughterhouse and named in jest by her rescuer, who then gives her a barn of her own. She wears a star-shaped brand and a patch over her face.

feats.scene: Rnerer kicks a barn door off its hinges when startled.
Rnerer shrugs off a stumble down a hay loft ladder.

reply.summary: Ricel is an orphan boy changed by a holiday spirit into a pint-sized hero of a nursery school squad. He helps save the festival with a costume and a good heart.

feats.scene: Ricel hurls a snowball that knocks a thief's hat off.
Ricel tumbles off a sled and bounces back up.

reply.summary: Unosan is an impish prankster from a higher dimension who makes anything he wants appear, usually to test the patience of a hero he adores. He is summoned with a rival trickster to pit champions against each other.

feats.scene: Unosan conjures a towering monster that tramples a city block.
Unosan is flung across a rooftop and pops up grinning.

reply.summary: Sornanseo is a black-eyed imp and part-time shopkeeper who flits about, teleports, flies and throws small blades. He is a gleeful fan who tags along uninvited.

feats.scene: Sornanseo flings a bundle of small boomerang blades into a wall and shatters the brick.
Sornanseo is swatted across a shop floor and bounces up.
Sornanseo zooms through a crowded aisle on a magic whim.
